extensionDescription.message: Compare client messages with locally saved approved scope.

headerSubtitle.message: Manage clients, approved scope, templates, and local backups.

scopeHelp.message: Enter one agreed deliverable or boundary per line.

thresholdHelp.message: Each scope item gets 70% exact-token overlap plus a 30% whole-phrase bonus. A task-like request is flagged only when its best item score is below this value. This is a deterministic suggestion, not a block.

deleteConfirm.message: Delete this client and its approved scope from this browser?

clientSaved.message: Client and approved scope saved on this device.

operationError.message: Could not complete the change. Check extension storage and try again.

clientNameRequired.message: Enter a client name before continuing.

licenseInstructions.message: Enter your local license key to start. This temporary check runs only on this device.

licenseInvalid.message: Use the format SCP-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX with letters or numbers in each group.

onboardingDoneHelp.message: Your client and approved scope will be stored locally. You can edit them at any time.

scopeRequired.message: Enter at least one approved scope item.

onboardingComplete.message: Setup complete. Choose this client for the conversation you review.

importConfirm.message: Importing replaces all currently saved clients and scopes. Continue?

importInvalid.message: That file is not a valid ScopePing backup.

importTooLarge.message: The backup file is too large to import.

integrationWarning.message: ScopePing could not complete a review on $1. Check the message layout and extension storage.

siteLayoutWarning.message: ScopePing could not safely review a message on $1. Check the page layout and retry.

privacyNotice.message: Local suggestions only · Nothing is sent automatically

licenseRequired.message: Activate ScopePing in Options to review messages.

noActiveClient.message: No active client selected. Choose a client in Options.

saveScopeFirst.message: Save approved scope in Options before reviewing requests.

emptyMessage.message: This message has no readable text to review.

reviewError.message: ScopePing could not review this message. Try again or open Options.

noScopeMatch.message: No matching scope item was found.

longMessageTrimmed.message: This message was long; only its first portion was reviewed.

manualSendReminder.message: Draft only. Review and send it yourself.

clipboardWarning.message: ScopePing could not write to the clipboard. The draft is selected for manual copying.
